description: Create new deployment of script_id (API executable, web app, etc.). Use after appscript_update_content. Not for run — use appscript_evaluate_function.
name: appscript_create_deployment

description: Create empty Apps Script project (title). Returns script_id. Then appscript_update_content.
name: appscript_create_project

description: Snapshot current script code as immutable version on script_id. Use before risky deploys. Versions cannot be edited — appscript_create_version again for new snapshot.
name: appscript_create_version

description: Delete deployment by deployment_id on script_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear.
name: appscript_delete_deployment

description: Permanently delete script_id and all files. Cannot undo — confirm always. Not for undeploy only — use appscript_delete_deployment.

script_id.description: The script project ID to delete.

name: appscript_delete_project

description: Run a deployed function (script_id + function_name). Confirm side effects. Deployments: appscript_list_deployments.
name: appscript_evaluate_function

description: Generate trigger setup snippet (API cannot add triggers). Paste into the script editor.

schedule.description: Interval/hour/weekday when needed for time_* types.

name: appscript_generate_trigger_code

description: Read one source file by script_id + file_name. Full project: appscript_get_project.
name: appscript_get_content

description: Execution metrics for script_id (usage stats). Use for monitoring. Not live run — use appscript_evaluate_function or appscript_list_processes.

metrics_granularity.description: Granularity of metrics — "DAILY" or "WEEKLY". Defaults to "DAILY".

name: appscript_get_metrics

description: Get project metadata + all source for script_id. Prefer appscript_get_content for one file.

script_id.description: Script id from appscript_list_projects or appscript_create_project.

name: appscript_get_project

description: Get one script version by version number on script_id. Use after appscript_list_versions.

version_number.description: The version number to retrieve (1, 2, 3, etc.).

name: appscript_get_version

description: List deployments for script_id (deployment ids, entry points). Use before appscript_evaluate_function or appscript_update_deployment.
name: appscript_list_deployments

description: Recent script execution processes (status, errors). Use for 'why did my script fail'. Not project source — use appscript_get_project.
name: appscript_list_processes

description: List Apps Script projects (script_id, title). Then appscript_get_project. Not run — appscript_evaluate_function.
name: appscript_list_projects

description: List immutable versions for script_id. Use before appscript_get_version or appscript_create_deployment. Snapshots for rollback — appscript_create_version to add new.
name: appscript_list_versions

description: Create/update .gs files in script_id. Not execute — appscript_evaluate_function.
name: appscript_update_content

description: Update deployment config by deployment_id on script_id. Not for delete — use appscript_delete_deployment.
name: appscript_update_deployment

description: Rare re-auth escape hatch. Prefer human CLI setup: `google-mcp auth` (or login) once; MCP tools refresh tokens automatically. Returns an auth URL if re-auth is needed. Disabled when MCP_ENABLE_OAUTH21=true. Requires service_name (e.g. Gmail).

service_name.description: Name of the Google service requiring authentication (e.g., 'Google Calendar', 'Gmail')

user_google_email.description: User's Google email address for authentication

name: auth_generate_url

description: List Google accounts signed in on this host (email addresses only). Use to choose an account, then pass that address as user_google_email. Not for finding people — use contacts_search.
name: auth_list_accounts

description: Create one or many events in one call. Required: events[{summary, start_time, end_time}]. A single event is a one-element list. Attendees are invited by default. Existing events → calendar_update_events.

calendar_id.description: Default calendar id. Default: primary. Overridden per event.

events.description: Events to create. Each needs summary, start_time, end_time. Optional: description, location, attendees, timezone, calendar_id, add_google_meet, send_updates.

send_updates.description: Invite email policy for every event: all (default when attendees set), externalOnly, or none.

timezone.description: Default timezone (e.g. America/Los_Angeles). Overridden per event.

name: calendar_create_events

description: Delete an event. Required: event_id from calendar_list_events. Confirm when unclear.
name: calendar_delete_event

description: Get one event by event_id (details). Required: event_id from calendar_list_events. Day/range listing → calendar_list_events(time_min, time_max). Never event_id="primary" or a date.

event_id.description: Opaque event id from calendar_list_events (ID: …). Not 'primary' or a date.

name: calendar_get_event

description: List calendar ids/names. Skip for everyday primary work — use calendar_id="primary".
name: calendar_list_calendars

description: List every event in a time range in one call (title, times, id). Use for today/tomorrow / find before edit. Do not call calendar_get_event per event. Day query: time_min + time_max, calendar_id="primary". Change many → calendar_update_events.

time_max.description: Range end RFC3339. Default: time_min+24h. Pass both for a clean day query.

name: calendar_list_events

description: Busy blocks for one or more calendars (ids or person emails). Use for mutual availability / find a time between people. Titles → calendar_list_events. Book → calendar_create_events with attendees.

calendar_ids.description: Calendar ids or emails; pass 2+ for mutual free/busy. Default: primary.

name: calendar_search_freebusy

description: Update one or many events in one call (time, title, guests, location). Required: events[{event_id, …}] from calendar_list_events. A single event is a one-element list. New events → calendar_create_events.

calendar_id.description: Default calendar id. Default: primary. Overridden per event.

events.description: Events to change. Each needs event_id. Set only fields to change: summary, start_time, end_time, description, location, attendees, timezone, calendar_id, add_google_meet, send_updates.

send_updates.description: Guest email policy for every event: all (default when guests exist), externalOnly, or none.

timezone.description: Default timezone (e.g. America/Los_Angeles). Overridden per event.

name: calendar_update_events

description: Send a message to space_id. Confirm unless user asked to send. Required: space_id from chat_list_spaces (spaces/…). Read history → chat_list_messages.

space_id.description: Chat space resource name from chat_list_spaces (spaces/…). Not a display name.

name: chat_create_message

description: Read messages in space_id (paginated). Required: space_id from chat_list_spaces (spaces/…, not display name). Send → chat_create_message.

space_id.description: Chat space resource name from chat_list_spaces (spaces/…). Not a display name.

name: chat_list_messages

description: List Chat spaces (space_id like spaces/…, DMs, rooms). Use before chat_list_messages or chat_create_message. Message search → chat_search_messages.
name: chat_list_spaces

description: Search Chat messages by text. Optional space_id (spaces/… from chat_list_spaces). Full thread in one space → chat_list_messages.

space_id.description: Optional space resource name (spaces/…) to limit search.

name: chat_search_messages

description: Create many contacts in one call. Use for imports/bulk add. Prefer contacts_create for one person.

contacts.description: List of contact objects with fields: given_name, family_name, email, phone, organization, job_title.

name: contacts_batch_create

description: Delete many contacts by resource names. Destructive — confirm when unclear.

contact_ids.description: List of contact IDs to delete.

name: contacts_batch_delete

description: Update many contacts (replace fields each). Confirm bulk overwrites. Prefer contacts_update for one.

updates.description: List of update objects with fields: contact_id (required), given_name, family_name, email, phone, organization, job_title.

name: contacts_batch_update

description: Create a contact. Pass given_name/family_name and/or email/phone. Returns contact_id. Many people → contacts_batch_create.
name: contacts_create

description: Create a contact group/label. Use for 'new group called…'. Add members with contacts_update_group_members.

name.description: The name of the new contact group.

name: contacts_create_group

description: Delete one contact by contact_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear. Find id → contacts_search. Many → contacts_batch_delete.

contact_id.description: Contact id from contacts_search/list (people/c… or c…).

name: contacts_delete

description: Delete a contact group (label). Does not delete contacts. Destructive — confirm when unclear.

delete_contacts.description: If true, also delete contacts in the group (default: false).

group_id.description: The contact group ID to delete.

name: contacts_delete_group

description: Get one contact by contact_id (full fields). Required: contact_id from contacts_search/list (people/… or bare id). Lookup by name → contacts_search.

contact_id.description: Contact id from contacts_search/list (people/c… or c…). Not a display name.

name: contacts_get

description: Get one contact group + member list by group resource name. Use before adding/removing members.

max_members.description: Maximum number of members to return (default: 100, max: 1000).

name: contacts_get_group

description: List contacts (names, emails, phones, resource names). Use for 'show my contacts'. Find someone → contacts_search. One id → contacts_get.
name: contacts_list

description: List contact groups/labels (group ids + names). Use before contacts_update_group_members. Not individual people — use contacts_list.

page_size.description: Maximum number of groups to return (default: 100, max: 1000).

name: contacts_list_groups

description: Search contacts by name/email/phone (returns contact_id + fields). Use for 'find John's email'. Known id → contacts_get. Browse all → contacts_list.

query.description: Name, email, or phone to search.

name: contacts_search

description: Update a contact (replace provided fields). Required: contact_id from contacts_search. Confirm before overwriting. New person → contacts_create.

contact_id.description: Contact id from contacts_search/list (people/c… or c…).

name: contacts_update

description: Rename a contact group. Required group resource name. Not for membership — use contacts_update_group_members.

group_id.description: The contact group ID to update.

name.description: The new name for the contact group.

name: contacts_update_group

description: Add or remove contacts from a group. Required group id + contact resource names. Use after contacts_list_groups / contacts_search.

add_contact_ids.description: Contact IDs to add to the group.

remove_contact_ids.description: Contact IDs to remove from the group.

name: contacts_update_group_members

description: Multi-step / formatting edits on document_id (insert, format, tables, find_replace). Simple text insert/replace → docs_update_text.

document_id.description: ID of the document to update.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_batch_update

description: Export document_id to PDF saved in Drive. Use for 'save doc as PDF'. Not for editing body — use docs_update_text. Export URL only — drive_get_file_download_url.

document_id.description: ID of the Google Doc to export.

folder_id.description: Drive folder ID to save PDF in. If not provided, saves in root.

pdf_filename.description: Name for the PDF file. If not provided, uses original name + "_PDF".

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_convert_to_pdf

description: Create a Google Doc. Required: title. Returns document_id. Then docs_update_text / docs_get_content.
name: docs_create

description: Add a comment on a document. Required document_id + comment_content. Reply → docs_create_reply.

document_id.description: document id id or share URL.

name: docs_create_comment

description: Insert tables, lists, or page breaks at index in document_id. Use docs_get_structure for index. Tables with data: docs_create_table_with_data.

columns.description: Number of columns for table (required for table).

document_id.description: ID of the document to update.

rows.description: Number of rows for table (required for table).

text.description: Initial text content for list items.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_create_elements

description: Insert image in document_id from Drive file_id or URL at index. Use for 'add logo/picture'. Not text — use docs_update_text.

document_id.description: ID of the document to update.

image_source.description: Drive file ID or public image URL.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_create_image

description: Reply to comment_id on a document. Required document_id, comment_id, reply_content. Ids from docs_list_comments.

document_id.description: document id id or share URL.

name: docs_create_reply

description: Create table + fill cells in document_id at index (2D string array). MUST call docs_get_structure first; use index < total_length. Prefer over docs_create_elements + manual fill.

bold_headers.description: Whether to make first row bold (default: true).

document_id.description: ID of the document to update.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_create_table_with_data

description: Read plain text by document_id or share URL. Edit → docs_update_text. New doc → docs_create. Find by title → docs_search.

document_id.description: Document id or Docs/Drive share URL.

name: docs_get_content

description: Doc layout stats: total_length, indices, tables (safe insert index). Use BEFORE docs_create_table_with_data or docs_create_elements — pick index < total_length. Not full text — use docs_get_content.

detailed.description: Whether to return detailed structure information. Defaults to false.

document_id.description: ID of the document to inspect.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_get_structure

description: Debug table grid: rows/cols, cell indices, content. Use when populate failed or 'table not found'. Before populate_existing flows. Not general layout — use docs_get_structure.

document_id.description: ID of the document containing the table.

table_index.description: Which table to debug (0 = first table, 1 = second table, etc.). Defaults to 0.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_get_table_structure

description: List comments on a document. Required document_id. Not file body — use docs read tools.

document_id.description: document id id or share URL.

name: docs_list_comments

description: List Google Docs in a Drive folder_id (document ids + names). Use for 'docs in this folder'. Not title search — use docs_search.

folder_id.description: The ID of the folder to list docs from. Defaults to 'root'.

page_size.description: Maximum number of documents to return. Defaults to 100.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_list_in_folder

description: Resolve (close) comment_id on a document. Required document_id + comment_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear.

document_id.description: document id id or share URL.

name: docs_resolve_comment

description: Find Google Docs by title (returns document_id). Paste a share URL to resolve one doc. Use for 'find my doc called…'. Then docs_get_content. In-folder browse: docs_list_in_folder.

page_size.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Document title text or Docs/Drive share URL.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_search

description: Update header/footer content in document_id. Use for 'fix the header'. Not body text — use docs_update_text.

document_id.description: ID of the document to update.

section_type.description: Type of section to update ('header' or 'footer').

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_update_headers_footers

description: Apply heading styles (H1–H6) and/or paragraph alignment/spacing on a range in document_id. Use for 'make this a heading'. Inline bold: docs_update_text.

end_index.description: End position (exclusive) - should cover the entire paragraph.

heading_level.description: Heading level 0-6 (0 = NORMAL_TEXT, 1 = H1, 2 = H2, etc.).

indent_first_line.description: First line indent in points (e.g., 36 for 0.5 inch).

space_above.description: Space above paragraph in points (e.g., 12 for one line).

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_update_paragraph_style

description: Find/replace all occurrences of text in document_id. Use for 'change every X to Y'. Not for single indexed edit — use docs_update_text.

document_id.description: ID of the document to update.

match_case.description: Whether to match case exactly. Defaults to false.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: docs_update_replace

description: Insert or replace text at start_index in document_id. Required: document_id, start_index, text. Replace range: also end_index. Bold/colors → docs_batch_update. Global replace → docs_update_replace.

end_index.description: If set with text, replaces [start_index, end_index).

start_index.description: Insert/replace start index (use 1 near top of body).

text.description: Text to insert, or replacement text when end_index is set.

name: docs_update_text

description: Share file_id with multiple recipients (roles/expiry per person). Use for bulk sharing. Confirm when unclear. Prefer drive_create_permission for one recipient.

file_id.description: The ID of the file or folder to share. Required.

recipients.description: List of recipient objects. Each should have: email (str), role (str, optional, default 'reader'), share_type (str, optional, default 'user'), expiration_time (str, optional). For domain shares, use 'domain' field instead of 'email'.

send_notification.description: Whether to send notification emails. Defaults to true.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_batch_create_permission

description: Import content as a native Google Doc (returns document_id). Use for 'convert to Google Doc'. Then docs_get_content. Plain upload → drive_create_file.

file_name.description: Doc title (extension ignored / used for format hint).

name: drive_convert_to_doc

description: Duplicate a file by file_id. Returns new file id. Use for 'make a copy of…'. Not for in-place edits — use drive_update_file or app-specific tools.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to copy. Required.

new_name.description: New name for the copied file. If not provided, uses "Copy of [original name]".

parent_folder_id.description: The ID of the folder where the copy should be created. Defaults to 'root' (My Drive).

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_create_copy

description: Create a Drive file from content (returns file id + link). Use for 'save this to Drive'. MD/DOCX→Google Doc → drive_convert_to_doc.
name: drive_create_file

description: Share file_id with one recipient (email + role). Confirm sensitive shares. Link-only → share_type=anyone. Many people → drive_batch_create_permission. URL only → drive_get_shareable_link.

role.description: reader, commenter, or writer. Default: reader.

share_type.description: user, group, domain, or anyone. Default: user.

share_with.description: Recipient email (or domain). Omit for share_type=anyone.

name: drive_create_permission

description: Revoke access: remove permission_id on file_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear. List permissions with drive_get_file_permissions first.

file_id.description: The ID of the file or folder. Required.

permission_id.description: The ID of the permission to remove (from drive_get_file_permissions). Required.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_delete_permission

description: Read file by file_id (Docs→text, Sheets→CSV, Slides→text; else UTF-8). Use for 'what's in this file'. Download URL → drive_get_file_download_url. Edit Docs → docs_get_content.

file_id.description: Drive file id or share/edit URL.

name: drive_get_file_content

description: Download/export bytes for file_id (optional export_format: pdf/docx/xlsx/csv/pptx). Use when user needs the file. Prefer drive_get_file_content to read text in chat.

export_format.description: Native export: pdf, docx, xlsx, csv, pptx.

name: drive_get_file_download_url

description: File metadata + sharing permissions for file_id. Use before drive_create_permission or update/remove permission. Not for file body — use drive_get_file_content.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to check permissions for.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_get_file_permissions

description: Find a Drive file by name and report if link sharing is public. Use for 'is this doc public'. Prefer drive_search_files + drive_get_file_permissions for full control.

file_name.description: The name of the file to check.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_get_file_public_access

description: Get view/download link for file_id. Use after drive_search_files for the URL. Not for changing permissions — use drive_create_permission.
name: drive_get_shareable_link

description: Browse folder contents (optional folder_id; drive_id for shared drives). Use for 'what's in this folder'. Not for name search — use drive_search_files.

folder_id.description: The ID of the Google Drive folder. Defaults to 'root'.

include_items_from_all_drives.description: Whether items from all accessible shared drives should be included. Defaults to True.

page_size.description: The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 100.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_list_items

description: Find Drive files by title (falls back to fullText). Paste a share URL to resolve one file. Returns ids + names. Then drive_get_file_content / docs_get_content / sheets_get_values. Folder browse → drive_list_items.

query.description: File title text, share/edit URL, or Drive operators (name contains, mimeType=, …).

name: drive_search_files

description: Update Drive file metadata (name, description, parents) by file_id. Not for Doc/Sheet/Slide body edits — use Docs/Sheets/Slides tools.

add_parents.description: Comma-separated folder IDs to add as parents.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to update. Required.

mime_type.description: New MIME type (note: changing type may require content upload).

properties.description: Custom key-value properties for the file.

remove_parents.description: Comma-separated folder IDs to remove from parents.

trashed.description: Whether to move file to/from trash.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

writers_can_share.description: Whether editors can share the file.

name: drive_update_file

description: Transfer file/folder ownership by file_id (irreversible; you become editor). Confirm always. Same-domain/personal rules apply. Not for sharing only — use drive_create_permission.

file_id.description: The ID of the file or folder to transfer. Required.

move_to_new_owners_root.description: If true, moves the file to the new owner's My Drive root. Defaults to false.

new_owner_email.description: Email address of the new owner. Required.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_update_ownership

description: Change an existing permission on file_id. Required permission_id from drive_get_file_permissions. Not for new shares — use drive_create_permission.

file_id.description: The ID of the file or folder. Required.

permission_id.description: The ID of the permission to update (from drive_get_file_permissions). Required.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: drive_update_permission

description: Add/update/delete form items and metadata on form_id (questions, sections, settings). Use for 'add a question', restructure form. Prefer forms_get first. Not for reading responses — use forms_list_responses.

form_id.description: The ID of the form to update.

requests.description: List of update requests to apply. Supported types: createItem, updateItem, deleteItem, moveItem, updateFormInfo, updateSettings.

name: forms_batch_update

description: Create a Google Form. Required: title. Returns form_id + URLs. Then forms_batch_update / forms_get.
name: forms_create

description: Get form structure (title, questions, settings, URLs) by form_id. Not answers — use forms_list_responses.

form_id.description: Form id from forms_create or a prior result.

name: forms_get

description: Get one form submission by form_id + response_id. Use after forms_list_responses when you need full answers for one response.

response_id.description: The ID of the response to retrieve.

name: forms_get_response

description: List form responses for form_id (paginated). Use for 'show survey results', export answers. Prefer forms_get_response for one submission.

page_size.description: Maximum number of responses to return. Defaults to 10.

page_token.description: Token for retrieving next page of results.

name: forms_list_responses

description: Change publish/accept-response settings for form_id. Use for 'open/close the form'. Not for editing questions — use forms_batch_update.

form_id.description: The ID of the form to update publish settings for.

publish_as_template.description: Whether to publish as a template. Defaults to false.

require_authentication.description: Whether to require authentication to view/submit. Defaults to false.

name: forms_update_publish_settings

description: Batch add/remove labels on many message IDs. Use for bulk archive/label. Prefer gmail_update_message_labels for one message.

add_label_ids.description: Label IDs to add to messages.

message_ids.description: List of message IDs to modify.

remove_label_ids.description: Label IDs to remove from messages.

name: gmail_batch_update_message_labels

description: Create a Gmail DRAFT (not sent). Use for 'draft a reply', prepare mail for later. To send immediately use gmail_create_message after confirmation.

attachments.description: Optional list of attachments. Each can have: 'path' (file path, auto-encodes), OR 'content' (standard base64, not urlsafe) + 'filename'. Optional 'mime_type' (auto-detected from path if not provided).

body.description: Email body content (plain text or HTML).

from_email.description: "Send As" alias email (must be configured in Gmail settings).

in_reply_to.description: Message-ID of message being replied to.

references.description: Chain of Message-IDs for proper threading.

thread_id.description: Gmail thread ID to reply within.

name: gmail_create_draft

description: Create a Gmail filter (criteria + actions). Use for 'auto-archive mail from…'. Confirm before creating noisy rules.

action.description: Filter action object. Supports: forward, addLabelIds, removeLabelIds.

criteria.description: Filter criteria object. Supports: from, to, subject, query, negatedQuery, hasAttachment, excludeChats, size, sizeComparison.

name: gmail_create_filter

description: Send email now. Confirm with user unless they explicitly said send. Draft → gmail_create_draft. Read → gmail_search_messages / gmail_get_message.
name: gmail_create_message

description: Delete a Gmail filter by id (from gmail_list_filters). Destructive — confirm when unclear.

filter_id.description: ID of the filter to delete.

name: gmail_delete_filter

description: Download one Gmail attachment by message_id + attachment_id. Use when the user needs a file from mail. Not for message body — use gmail_get_message.

attachment_id.description: The ID of the attachment to download.

message_id.description: The ID of the Gmail message containing the attachment.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: gmail_get_attachment

description: Read one message by message_id (subject/from/body). After search. Many ids → gmail_get_messages_batch. Thread → gmail_get_thread.
name: gmail_get_message

description: Batch-read up to 25 messages by id (subject/from/body). Prefer over repeated gmail_get_message.
name: gmail_get_messages_batch

description: Read a full Gmail thread by thread_id (all messages). Use for 'show the whole conversation'. Prefer gmail_get_message for a single message.

thread_id.description: The unique ID of the Gmail thread to retrieve.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: gmail_get_thread

description: Batch-read up to 25 Gmail threads by ID. Use when summarizing several conversations. Prefer gmail_get_thread for one thread.

thread_ids.description: A list of Gmail thread IDs to retrieve. The function will automatically batch requests in chunks of 25.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: gmail_get_threads_batch

description: List configured Gmail filters. Use before create/delete filter or to audit automation rules.
name: gmail_list_filters

description: List Gmail labels (ids + names). Use before apply/remove labels or to discover label ids. Not for reading mail — use gmail_search_messages.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: gmail_list_labels

description: Search Gmail (from:, subject:, newer_than:, is:unread, …). Returns message/thread ids. Then gmail_get_message or gmail_get_messages_batch. Send → gmail_create_message.

page_token.description: Next page token from a prior result.

name: gmail_search_messages

description: Create/update/delete Gmail labels (label definitions). Use for 'make a label called…'. To apply labels to messages use gmail_update_message_labels.

label_id.description: Label ID. Required for update and delete.

name.description: Label name. Required for create, optional for update.

name: gmail_update_label

description: Add/remove labels on one message. Trash spam: add TRASH. Archive: remove INBOX. Mark spam: add SPAM. After gmail_search_messages. Many ids → gmail_batch_update_message_labels.

message_id.description: ID of the message to modify.

name: gmail_update_message_labels

description: Metadata about the configured Programmable Search Engine (cx). Needs GOOGLE_PSE_API_KEY + GOOGLE_PSE_ENGINE_ID. Not for running a query — use pse_search.
name: pse_get_engine_info

description: Programmable Search (needs GOOGLE_PSE_API_KEY + GOOGLE_PSE_ENGINE_ID). General web: use web_search. Not Gmail — use gmail_search_messages. Site-limited: pse_search_siterestrict.
name: pse_search

description: Web search limited to specific site(s) via Programmable Search. Needs GOOGLE_PSE_API_KEY + GOOGLE_PSE_ENGINE_ID. Broader web: web_search or pse_search.

num.description: Number of results to return (1-10). Defaults to 10.

sites.description: List of sites/domains to search within.

start.description: The index of the first result to return (1-based). Defaults to 1.

name: pse_search_siterestrict

description: Add a comment on a spreadsheet. Required spreadsheet_id + comment_content. Reply → sheets_create_reply.

spreadsheet_id.description: spreadsheet id id or share URL.

name: sheets_create_comment

description: Add conditional formatting rule on spreadsheet_id + range_name (condition_type, colors). Use for highlight rules. Update/delete by rule_index with update/sheets_delete_conditional_formatting.

condition_values.description: Values for the condition (JSON array or string)

name: sheets_create_conditional_formatting

description: Reply to comment_id on a spreadsheet. Required spreadsheet_id, comment_id, reply_content. Ids from sheets_list_comments.

spreadsheet_id.description: spreadsheet id id or share URL.

name: sheets_create_reply

description: Add a new tab (sheet_name) inside existing spreadsheet_id. Use for 'add a sheet called…'. Not a new file — use sheets_create_spreadsheet.
name: sheets_create_sheet

description: Create a spreadsheet. Required: title. Returns spreadsheet_id. Then sheets_update_values / sheets_get_values. New tab in existing file → sheets_create_sheet.
name: sheets_create_spreadsheet

description: Delete conditional formatting rule by rule_index on spreadsheet_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear. Not for add — use sheets_create_conditional_formatting.

rule_index.description: Index of the rule to delete (0-based)

name: sheets_delete_conditional_formatting

description: Apply colors/number formats to spreadsheet_id + range_name (#RRGGBB, NUMBER/CURRENCY/DATE, etc.). Use for styling cells. Not for values — use sheets_update_values.

number_format_pattern.description: Custom pattern for the number format

name: sheets_format_range

description: Spreadsheet title, locale, and sheet tabs for spreadsheet_id or share URL. Use before read/modify when you need tab names. Not for cell values — use sheets_get_values.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id or Sheets/Drive share URL

name: sheets_get_spreadsheet_info

description: Read a whole range in one call (many rows) from spreadsheet_id. Default A1:Z1000. Do not read one row per call. Several ranges: ranges=["Sheet1!A:D","Sheet2!A:C"]. Write → sheets_update_values.

range_name.description: A1 range covering every row you need. Default: A1:Z1000. Not one row.

ranges.description: Several A1 ranges in this same call. Omit to use range_name.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id or Sheets/Drive share URL.

name: sheets_get_values

description: List comments on a spreadsheet. Required spreadsheet_id. Not file body — use sheets read tools.

spreadsheet_id.description: spreadsheet id id or share URL.

name: sheets_list_comments

description: List/filter spreadsheets (name, spreadsheet_id, modified time). Optional query filters by title. Paste a share URL to resolve one sheet. Use before sheets_get_values. Not for other Drive files — use drive_search_files.

max_results.description: Maximum number of spreadsheets to return (default 25)

query.description: Optional title text or share/edit URL. Omit to list recent spreadsheets.

name: sheets_list_spreadsheets

description: Resolve (close) comment_id on a spreadsheet. Required spreadsheet_id + comment_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear.

spreadsheet_id.description: spreadsheet id id or share URL.

name: sheets_resolve_comment

description: Update conditional formatting by rule_index on spreadsheet_id. Optional new range/condition/colors. Not for new rules — use sheets_create_conditional_formatting.

rule_index.description: Index of the rule to update (0-based)

sheet_name.description: Sheet name when range_name is omitted

name: sheets_update_conditional_formatting

description: Write many rows in one call: spreadsheet_id + range_name + values (2D array of every row). Do not call once per row. Several ranges: updates=[{range_name, values}]. Clear: clear_values=true. Read → sheets_get_values.

clear_values.description: If true, clear range_name instead of writing.

range_name.description: A1 range covering every row (e.g. Sheet1!A1). Required unless updates is set.

spreadsheet_id.description: Spreadsheet id or Sheets/Drive share URL.

updates.description: Several ranges in this same call: [{range_name, values}]. Prefer this over one call per row or range.

values.description: 2D cell values for range_name. One entry per row, e.g. [["a","b"],["1","2"]]. Include every row in this array.

name: sheets_update_values

description: Apply Slides batch updates on presentation_id (add slides, text, shapes). Prefer slides_get_presentation first.

presentation_id.description: The ID of the presentation to update.

requests.description: List of update requests to apply.

name: slides_batch_update

description: Add a comment on a presentation. Required presentation_id + comment_content. Reply → slides_create_reply.

presentation_id.description: presentation id id or share URL.

name: slides_create_comment

description: Create a Slides deck. Optional title. Returns presentation_id. Then slides_batch_update / slides_get_presentation.
name: slides_create_presentation

description: Reply to comment_id on a presentation. Required presentation_id, comment_id, reply_content. Ids from slides_list_comments.

presentation_id.description: presentation id id or share URL.

name: slides_create_reply

description: Get one slide/page (elements) by presentation_id + page_object_id. Not thumbnail — use slides_get_page_thumbnail.

page_object_id.description: The object ID of the page/slide to retrieve.

name: slides_get_page

description: Thumbnail image URL for presentation_id + page_id. Use when user needs a slide preview. Not full slide JSON — use slides_get_page.

page_object_id.description: The object ID of the page/slide.

name: slides_get_page_thumbnail

description: Get deck metadata + slide/page ids for presentation_id. Then slides_get_page or slides_batch_update. Not thumbnail — use slides_get_page_thumbnail.

presentation_id.description: Presentation id from slides_create_presentation or a prior result.

name: slides_get_presentation

description: List comments on a presentation. Required presentation_id. Not file body — use slides read tools.

presentation_id.description: presentation id id or share URL.

name: slides_list_comments

description: Resolve (close) comment_id on a presentation. Required presentation_id + comment_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear.

presentation_id.description: presentation id id or share URL.

name: slides_resolve_comment

description: Add a to-do (returns task_id). Use for 'remind me to…', new task. Prefer task_list_id="@default". Not for edits — use tasks_update_task.

task_list_id.description: Task list id. Use "@default" for the account default list.

name: tasks_create_task

description: Create a new Google Tasks list. Use for 'make a list called…'. Returns tasklist_id for tasks_create_task / tasks_list_tasks.

title.description: The title of the new task list.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: tasks_create_tasklist

description: Clear/hide all completed tasks in a tasklist_id. Required tasklist_id. Confirm when unclear — removes completed items from the active view.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the task list to clear completed tasks from.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: tasks_delete_completed

description: Delete one task by task_list_id + task_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear. Prefer mark completed via tasks_update_task when unsure.

task_list_id.description: Task list id. Use "@default" for the account default list.

name: tasks_delete_task

description: Delete a task list and ALL its tasks. Required tasklist_id. Destructive — confirm when unclear. Not for single tasks — use tasks_delete_task.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the task list to delete.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: tasks_delete_tasklist

description: Get one task (title, due, notes, status). Use before update/delete. Prefer tasks_list_tasks first for task_id. Required: task_list_id + task_id.

task_list_id.description: Task list id. Use "@default" for the account default list.

name: tasks_get_task

description: Get one task list by tasklist_id (title, etag). Use after tasks_list_tasklists. Not for individual tasks — use tasks_get_task / tasks_list_tasks.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the task list to retrieve.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: tasks_get_tasklist

description: List Google Tasks lists (tasklist_id + title). Use for 'what lists do I have' before tasks_list_tasks. Not for tasks inside a list — use tasks_list_tasks.

max_results.description: Maximum number of task lists to return (default: 1000, max: 1000).

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: tasks_list_tasklists

description: List tasks in a list (title, due, status, task_id). Use for 'what's on my to-do'. Prefer task_list_id="@default". Not for list names — use tasks_list_tasklists (complete tier).

task_list_id.description: Task list id. Use "@default" for the account default list.

name: tasks_list_tasks

description: Update a task (title, notes, due, status). Required task_list_id + task_id from tasks_list_tasks. Mark done: status="completed". Not for new tasks — use tasks_create_task.

task_list_id.description: Task list id. Use "@default" for the account default list.

name: tasks_update_task

description: Reorder a task or move it to another tasklist_id / parent task. Required tasklist_id + task_id. Use after tasks_list_tasks when reorganizing.

destination_task_list.description: Destination task list ID (for moving between lists).

parent.description: New parent task ID (for making it a subtask).

task_id.description: The ID of the task to move.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the current task list containing the task.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: tasks_update_task_position

description: Rename or update a task list. Required tasklist_id from tasks_list_tasklists. Not for tasks — use tasks_update_task.

task_list_id.description: The ID of the task list to update.

title.description: The new title for the task list.

user_google_email.description: The user's Google email address. Required.

name: tasks_update_tasklist
